_doc: Clip theo lỗi L1 của người học ngôn ngữ này (docs/specs/social-l1-clips.md). Giáo viên nói tiếng Anh ≤B1; native.* = bản tay (tầng i18n-fixed), {m:từ[#nghĩa]} lấy nghĩa từ web/packs/<lang>.json (vi: kho từ).

mistake.en: Using become for “to receive” (I become a letter)
mistake.vi: Dùng become với nghĩa "nhận": "I become a letter" (tiếng Đức: bekommen = nhận)
mistake.l1: German “bekommen” means to receive, a false friend of “become”.

hook.bad: I become a letter from my bank
hook.good: I get a letter from my bank

segments.text: Don't say, I become a letter from my bank. Say, I get a letter from my bank.
Become means to change into something. To receive something, say get.
Repeat after me. I get a letter. I get a gift.
Nice! Get is a very useful word.

native.caption: Im Deutschen heißt “bekommen” empfangen, aber das englische “become” bedeutet werden. Wenn du etwas bekommst, sagst du “get”: “I get a letter from my bank”, nicht “I become a letter”. Sprich Carlos nach und übe Grammatik in der Lexkite-App.

en.caption: In German “bekommen” means to receive, but the English “become” means to turn into something. To receive something, say “get”: “I get a letter from my bank”, not “I become a letter”. Repeat after Carlos and practice grammar in the Lexkite app.
